raw_segments.text: I, no doubt. But that is what a governess will prevent, and if I had known your mother,
I should have advised her most strenuously to engage one. I always say that nothing is
to be done in education without steady and regular instruction, and nobody but a governess
can give it. It is wonderful how many families I have been the means of supplying in that
way. I am always glad to get a young person well placed out.
Four nieces of Mrs. Jenkinson are most delightfully situated through my means, and it was but
the other day that I recommended another young person, who was merely accidentally mentioned
to me, and the family are quite delighted with her. Mrs. Collins, did I tell you of
Lady Metcalfe's calling yesterday to thank me? She finds Miss Pope a treasure.
